title: The Hollow Hollow Revisited
author: Cyrus Dravenmoor
blurb: Sable Quintana, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
